findings.title: ActivateModified ignored when Activate is nil
findings.message: The guard requires Activate != nil before checking ActivateModified. A node that sets only ActivateModified will never fire; also the nested ActivateModified branch is only reachable when Activate is set.

findings.title: Selection state restored via undo not verified
findings.message: Deleting multiple selected bodies is applied while the browser's plain-select handler (ModelBrowserSelect) in view.go still calls selectObject; but more importantly, when Selection contains multiple ids and Selected is the last one, the code path is consistent. However, clone() now clones Selection but `before` in apply is captured after the mutation of shared backing arrays: features := s.Features[:0] reuses the cloned slice, which is safe. The real problem is that undo restores Selection from `before` while the apply closure reads `after`; both are cloned, so OK. Low risk but unverified.
findings.suggestion: Add a test that checks Selection after undo/redo.
findings.evidence: s.Objects = slices.DeleteFunc(s.Objects, func(o viewport.Object) bool { return selected[o.ID] })
